## `SCI-NOI-ASM-001` - exact authority

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-002` - frozen numerical parent gates

The selected ordinary route remains numerically unavailable until its exact
PTC MAP-facing coefficient family/value/QC, numerical `coverage_cut`
state/value/failure policy, and every exact parent/admission fact are realized.
No equation in this draft creates those parents or infers a default.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-003` - fixed operator

For the ordinary method, the exact admitted occurrence population,
coefficients, projection, normalization, WCS, support, boundary, response
handling, validity, and MAP-local gates are identical for the real signal and
every realization. Re-estimation or reselection creates another method.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-004` - target-law complement symmetry

ODQ-102C supplies a complement-symmetric network-stratified coefficient-mass
balance family with marginal detector sign probability `1/2`. It does not
supply the detailed finite design, realized independence, count balance, or
pixelwise source cancellation.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-005` - detailed design remains pending

ODQ-102D delegates an implementation-blind author proposal but does not accept
its mechanics in advance. Tolerance, population edge cases, candidate law,
search, retry, replacement, complement occurrence, duplicate/equivalence,
rank, weights, count domain, generator/keying, and observation-product scope
remain unavailable until the owner accepts one exact complete candidate.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-006` - conditional target only

The fixed parent can contain astronomical source and structured residuals.
The conditional detector-sign law is not assumed equal to repeated physical
noise, total MAP uncertainty, a source-free null, or a calibrated tail law.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-007` - atomic completion

ODQ-105A supplies the all-admitted-member completion rule. Candidate
construction rejection is not member failure. Once admitted, member failure
fails the ensemble for base UNC; diagnostics do not become survivor inference.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-008` - no distributional significance model

No Gaussian, Student, pivotal, random-field, search, selection, multiplicity,
false-alarm, completeness, purity, or catalog model is supplied.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-009` - immutable successors

Adjacent parents and prior NOI products are immutable. Owner-defined
transformation, Wiener, and FRUIT routes require exact external authority and
new generations whenever learning, selection, continuation, or replay changes.

## `SCI-NOI-ASM-010` - profile revision boundary

The four exact Stage A NOI profile bytes are registered. r0.2 symbol or action
changes do not silently rewrite them. Any affected r0.2 evaluation remains
unavailable until an exact immutable profile/Registry successor is approved
and bound.
